AI plus-size body transformation — visualize how a person would look extremely overweight

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of fat-ai-cli-skill:

- Introduces an AI-powered tool to visualize extreme overweight body transformations from a portrait photo.
- Requires installation of weshop-cli and configuration of the WESHOP_API_KEY environment variable.
- Provides a CLI command (weshop fat-ai) with options for image input and customization prompts.
- Includes strong API key security guidelines and user instructions.
- Returns result URLs with transformed images in a structured output.
